title: Lesson 7: Air Changes, Consolidation & Grade 1 Review
summary: This short module serves as the final consolidation lesson for JustinGuitar's Grade 1 (White Grade). The host outlines a recap of the eight core chord shapes, revisits chord-change strategies, and introduces the Air Changes technique to speed up transitions. He also notes the value of hitting open strings between chord changes and frames practice as a personalized, adaptive routine. In addition to core technique, the video introduces optional extras—ear training and music theory—and emphasizes self-assessment to customize practice toward passing Grade 1 and progressing to Grade 2. The content is framed as a structured coaching moment: consolidate fundamentals, rehearse efficient changes, and set up a practical plan for ongoing improvement.
topics: Review of the eight core chord shapes (Grade 1, White Grade)
Air Changes technique for faster changes
Hitting open strings between chord changes
Timing and impact of open-string notes between changes
Grade progression: moving from Grade 1 to Grade 2
